full_judgment: 3. Defendant Nos.4 and 6 filed an application under Order VII rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure for rejection of the plaint on the grounds that the suit was barred by reason of the Administrative Tribunals Act, 1980 which got exclusive jurisdiction to try such a matter, that the suit was barred under section 42 of the Specific Relief Act, that the matter was triable by the Labour Court and that the suit was barred under the Limitation Act.
